== frame after_pwd cursor=4,30
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ 'space dir'
|testuser@<HOST> ~/space dir $ pwd
|<HOME>/space dir
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/space dir $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 'space
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/space dir
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 pwd
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/space dir
